parameters.content:
## MCP - Web Scraper

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/web-scraper

**Parameters:**
- `url` (required): URL to scrape
- `options.render_js` (optional): auto | true | false (default: false)
- `options.extract_content` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `options.include_html` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `options.screenshot` (optional): boolean (default: false)
- `options.wait_for` (optional): networkidle | domcontentloaded | selector:#main
- `options.timeout_ms` (optional): Timeout in ms (default: 60000)
- `execution_mode` (optional): online | offline

**Returns:** HTML, extracted content (title, text, excerpt, byline), status code

**Note:** This is a simple HTTP-based scraper. For JS-heavy sites, use render_js: true (requires Playwright microservice)
